name: document-files
description: Read, extract structure and values, convert, render, create, edit, and verify local document files.

interface.shortDescription: Headless document reading and file operations
interface.longDescription: Inspect and extract text, source structure, semantic roles, and explicit values from PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HWP, HWPX, HTML, Markdown, and text files; convert and render supported formats; and create, edit, and verify HWPX artifacts. Sources remain unchanged, outputs are separate, extraction coverage is explicit, and private work files stay outside the plugin package.
